steps.name: 1. Resolve Alice identity via Web OAuth provider mapping
2. Resolve Alice identity via Bot signed assertion mapping
3. Resolve Bob identity via Bot signed assertion mapping
4. Submit recovery job on behalf of Alice
5. Alice queries her own recovery job via Bot Adapter
6. Bob queries Alice recovery job via Bot Adapter (Forbidden 403)
7. Bob attempts to cancel Alice recovery job (Forbidden 403)
8. Alice cancels her own recovery job (Allowed 200)
